title: Parameter - quoted onclick
description: The parameter is echoed in an HTML event handler attribute, double quoted, i.e. <div onclick="%q">

Parameter - Quoted onclick

The q parameter is echoed inside a double-quoted onclick attribute.

Param: ?q=

⬇️ Click the button below to trigger the event handler:
objectives: Inject JavaScript directly into the onclick handler.
Break out of the double quotes to add auto-executing attributes.
hints: You can provide direct JS (e.g. alert(1)) or escape quotes: " autofocus onfocus="alert(1).
